text: The tool is not the project.
An idea without execution has little value.
A website with no traffic / conversion / business objective can be just a showcase.
AI gets stronger inside a workflow.
Automation without a clear business process = complexity.
Best projects combine Problem + Customer + Distribution + Revenue.
Local AI isn't always best, cloud isn't always best.
Open source can be excellent infrastructure.
One small real project beats ten theoretical ideas.
